# DAB Hands

> DAB Hands keeps important work moving. Senior operational leadership for organisations where good thinking needs to survive the journey from decision to delivery.

DAB Hands is the digital home of Darren Brett, a senior operator with the heart of a creative. Not a consultancy, not an agency, not a transformation practice. I am brought in when important work needs to keep moving, from focused operational leadership to longer-running support. Backed by more than 20 years helping global brands and tier-one agencies move important digital work from idea to market, with its momentum, quality and intent intact.

## What I do

Most organisations already have what they need: capable people, clear ambition, meaningful work. The challenge is rarely creating more. It is creating the conditions where all of it consistently turns into impact. I provide the operational leadership that makes that happen.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dabhands.delivery/): The proposition and point of view. Keeping important work moving. Most organisations don’t lack good thinking; they struggle to preserve it.
- [For Business & Agency Leaders](https://dabhands.delivery/business-and-agency-leaders): For leaders of growing organisations where good thinking gets harder to land. Experienced operational leadership that closes the gap between what leadership teams intend to deliver and what actually gets done.
- [For Marketing Leaders](https://dabhands.delivery/marketing-leaders): For marketing leaders who need their strongest ideas to reach customers with full impact. Helping great work keep its power on the journey from strategy to the customer, across campaigns, launches and experiences.
- [For Growth-Stage Businesses](https://dabhands.delivery/growth-stage-businesses): For founder-led and growth-stage businesses where growth creates complexity faster than capability. Building the structure to sustain what’s been created, so success creates momentum, not complexity.
- [Contact](https://dabhands.delivery/contact): Get in touch about important work that needs to create real impact.
